warrants.quote: Series A warrants to purchase 5,089,060 shares of common stock (the “Series A Warrants”)
Series B warrants to purchase up to 7,633,591 shares of common stock (the “Series B Warrants”)
The Pre-Funded Warrant has an exercise price of $0.001 per share and is immediately exercisable and will expire when exercised in full
to purchase up to 127,227 shares of common stock (which represents 5% of the sum of the shares of common stock and Pre-Funded Warrants sold to the institutional investor in the Offering)
